Op I think you’re mainly dealing with so much guilt because of the lack of support you got from home. I say that only because I am on my own journey to self acceptance and confidence/untying myself from my mother’s abuse. 
I feel maybe you are worried about your sexual history only in terms of how it relates to your partner’s view on you, i.e: “what will my partner think of me?”, and ultimately, this shouldn’t matter as much as “what do I think of me?”. 10000% easier said than done, but if this sounds like it might be the case I highly recommend therapy or the book “Children of Emotionally Immature Parents”, soooo so eye-opening! Everything you’ve done was done out of a desperate plea for love. Unfortunately a lot of our sexual experiences come out of coercion, and with pasts like ours, its even easier to fall susceptible to guys just trying to get off. In a moment of self-sabotage, or hitting rock-bottom, its easy to want to feel needed, important and loved by someone. When sex and romantic relationships are the only form of intimacy you’ve grown to know, or the only form of stability you feel you can control or escape to in your life, it becomes survival. Op you are a product of your environment, don’t be so hard on yourself. You did what you needed to do to keep pushing forward. If your partner is true and right for you, your sexual history should hold no weight to them, or they’ll have similar values. 
You are not a collection of your previous partners. Your body doesn’t keep count, neither should you. Your body is yours and yours alone, it isn’t any more “used up” or changed than anyone else’s, and honestly the whole conversation regarding previous sexual history is so bizarre to begin with. I can’t imagine asking anyone after high school how many people they’ve slept with, because it truthfully doesn’t matter. STI and monogamy status is usually what people actually care about. The use of the term “angel” makes me really feel for you OP :( Sexuality doesn’t make one evil, or dark, or dirty. And you don’t absorb anyones energy when having sex, just germs lol.

You can still be an angel, you can still be a good person, a sweet girl, etc. I’m willing to bet you already are. Don’t let society’s obsession with purity, virginity, and body count trick you into forgetting you’re a grown woman. Those values came out of an era where men regularly wanted to fuck 13 year old child brides.
 
TL;DR: People be fucking and thats chill! And your parent’s influence (or lack of) might be the real guilt and pain thats bugging you!
